Hi Elena —

Great to hear Novacore is moving forward with a structured bakeoff. We can generally accommodate that level of trial credits, but need to align internally on a few guardrails:

1) Stipend model: we usually issue a single pooled credit allocation per deal (60k tokens or equivalent) tied to the HubSpot deal record rather than per-project to prevent stacking across separate accounts. If Novacore requires per-team isolation, we can split the pool across three project aliases but the total committed spend would remain the same unless a top-up is approved.

2) Timing: 30-day windows are fine; we prefer a start date after a quick kickoff (we can do provisioning within 48 hours of signed acknowledgment).

3) Security/procurement: Marissa will follow up with SOC 2 artifacts and an ops contact for the procurement team.

I attached a short evaluation scope template and trial terms for review. If procurement needs a contract addendum we can route through Legal — that will add ~3 business days.

- Ben: finance OK to approve a one-time 180k-token equivalent allocation if we treat it as a single deal-level stipend?
